references.text: Joseph's sons Ephraim and Manasseh were born in Egypt. Ephraim was named by Joseph, and these verses explain the origin of the tribe of Ephraim.
Jacob blesses Joseph's sons Ephraim and Manasseh, where Ephraim receives the greater blessing even though he was the younger. This establishes Ephraim as a significant tribe in Israel.
Ephraim and Manasseh are mentioned as Joseph's sons who were born in Egypt, confirming their descent from Joseph.
The tribe of Ephraim and its leader Elishama are mentioned in connection with the camp arrangement, showing the tribe's organization after the census.
The second census of the tribe of Ephraim, showing the clans and numbers of the tribe after the wilderness journey.
Moses' blessing over Joseph includes Ephraim and describes the tribe's strength and power.
The tribe of Ephraim receives its inheritance in the promised land, fulfilling the promises given to Joseph's descendants.
